name: NetMask Ninja
description: A fast, keyboard-friendly IPv4 subnet tool. One field takes a CIDR or an address with a dotted mask and returns net, broadcast, host span, wildcard, usable count, class and address kind, plus the mask in binary. Extra tabs divide a block into equal subnets, compress an address span into CIDR notation and match an address against a network. Pure local math.

browser_action.default_title: NetMask Ninja — Slice networks in one keystroke
